cases.customer_question: Why does the Qualcomm BLE Direct Mode utility fail to run or communicate correctly during RF PHY qualification setup?
question_variants: Why is the Qualcomm DTM tool failing?
What files are required for Qualcomm BLE Direct Mode?
How should the Qualcomm DTM executable be installed?
Why is the BLE DTM utility not connecting to the DUT?
cases.actual_issue: The Qualcomm BLE Direct Mode executable required additional runtime dependency files and correct serial configuration, but only the executable itself had initially been copied into the qualification environment.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The qualification setup used a Qualcomm utility to control Bluetooth Direct Test Mode, but the tool would not run properly because supporting files were missing. The issue was not only the main executable but also the related DLL and runtime files required for operation. Incorrect serial settings could also prevent the tester from communicating with the DUT.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant initially attempted to use only the QC.BluetoothLE_DirectMode.exe file inside the qualification environment, but later recognized that the utility depended on additional DLL and potentially OCX files located in the original installation directory. The consultant corrected the setup guidance by instructing that all associated runtime files be copied together. The discussion also clarified that the serial interface needed to operate in HCI-Serial mode at the specified baud configuration for proper tester communication.
cases.decision_logic: Vendor-specific DTM tools often rely on supporting runtime components and precise serial communication settings. Successful RF PHY qualification setup depends on reproducing the complete runtime environment rather than copying a single executable in isolation.
cases.final_recommendation: Copy the full Qualcomm DTM utility directory including all dependent runtime files, configure the DUT serial interface for HCI-Serial communication, verify baud rate and COM assignments, and confirm tool operation before scheduling RF PHY execution.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: The DTM utility may fail to launch or communicate with the DUT, causing repeated troubleshooting sessions and delays to RF PHY qualification execution.
